biotools.summary: sigscores is an R package designed to compute summary scores for molecular signatures, helping to convert complex multi-feature profiles into single, statistically sound biomarkers. It provides various scoring metrics, significance assessment, and visualization tools for large-scale analyses of multi-omics data.
